records: Bithomp account balances are dynamic explorer page observations without a signed data snapshot hash. The receiver's page displays 233.5M XRP and no transactions found at capture, but later movement remains possible.

Bithomp labels are provider attribution, not an official Binance PoR address-file match. The five source accounts' current balances do not establish their inclusion in Binance's official October 1 PoR wallet set.

XRP Insights' exchange-balance dataset is aggregate-only; its public JSON endpoint does not expose per-wallet historical balances. The five compromised accounts cannot be crosswalked to the 153 Binance wallets from this dataset.

Binance's 2.80B Oct29 and 2.58B Oct30 exchange totals are rounded. The approximate 220M decline is close to, but not equal to, the 233.4619431M theft total. Other wallet inflows/outflows, reserve movements, classification and rounding prevent direct attribution.

The 11.141M XRP and 51.173M RLUSD movements from rDAE... to Binance-labelled rs8Z... are internal-labelled transfers. They are not proof that stolen XRP was recovered or that user balances were restored.

SBI VC Trade's 10.5M XRP 30-day attributed-wallet decline and Coinbase's 1.1M 7-day increase are not customer flows, lending volumes or proof of migration. Both aggregate series include custody/operational balances.
